attchmntText: Time Technoplast Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Time Technoplast Limited has submitted the transcript of the conference call held on November 06, 2026, to the National Stock Exchange of India Ltd. and BSE Limited. The call discussed Q2 and H1FY27 Results. The transcript is available on the company website at https://www.timetechnoplast.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/q2-transcript-2026.pdf. The submission was made by Bharat Kumar Vageria, Managing Director, DIN 00183629.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the Quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Time Technoplast Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by CARE Ratings Limited. The report monitors the utilization of proceeds from a Qualified Institutional Placement aggregating Rs. 800.00 crore. The Monitoring Agency confirmed no deviation from the objects of the issue. However, the report noted comingling of funds in the current account of Time Ecotech Private Limited. The company has utilized Rs. 400.00 crore for repayment of outstanding borrowings. Expenditure of Rs. 18.90 crore was incurred for machinery and equipment. An additional Rs. 1.44 crore was utilized by the subsidiary for recycling plant equipment. Some government approvals for recycling plants at Gadarpur, Uttarakhand, remain pending. The report was reviewed by the Audit Committee and noted by the Board of Directors.

attchmntText: Time Technoplast Limited has informed the Exchange about Receiving of an Additional Order from one of India's leading Public-Sector Oil Marketing Company for Supply of Composite LPG Cylinders for INR 38.14 crore.
voiceSummary: Time Technoplast Limited has received an additional order from a public-sector oil marketing company for the supply of Type IV Composite LPG Cylinders. The order quantity has been enhanced from 1,40,000 units to 2,80,000 units. The total order value has increased from approximately Rs. 38.14 crore to Rs. 76.28 crore. The additional order value is Rs. 38.14 crore. The order is domestic in nature. Execution is to be completed within six months. The awarding entity is a domestic entity. There is no interest held by promoters or group companies in the entity that awarded the order. The order does not fall within related party transactions. The announcement was signed by Managing Director Bharat Kumar Vageria.
